paras: Over 40 years of motorsport engineering distilled into a street-ready coilover kit. The Öhlins Road & Track series delivers a genuine racing experience without sacrificing daily drivability — thanks to Öhlins' proprietary Dual Flow Valve (DFV) technology. This FWD-specific kit (VWS MU21S1) features matched 70 N/mm front and rear spring rates, tuned for front-wheel drive platforms. Springs included. Weight reduction of approx. 10kg compared to original suspension.
⚠️ FWD models only. For AWD / Quattro / 4Motion models, see VWS MU21S2.
